user_query: Determine the enzyme represented by this sequence. Focus on curated or well-supported catalytic activity and exact chemical reaction, distinguishing reference annotation from homology-based inference. Report accession/organism of strongest references and uncertainty.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: With CysD forms the ATP sulfurylase (ATPS) that catalyzes the adenylation of sulfate producing adenosine 5'-phosphosulfate (APS) and diphosphate, the first enzymatic step in sulfur assimilation pathway. APS synthesis involves the formation of a high-energy phosphoric-sulfuric acid anhydride bond driven by GTP hydrolysis by CysN coupled to ATP hydrolysis by CysD.
APS kinase catalyzes the synthesis of activated sulfate.
